Lower sodium intake
Consume no more than 2400 mg of sodium/day; 
further reduction of sodium to 1500 mg/day is de-
sirable because it is associated with even greater 
reduction in BP; reduce intake by at least 1000 
mg/day because that will lower BP, even if the de-
sired daily sodium intake is not achieved.

Dietary patterns em-

vegetables
Individuals should adopt the DASH di-
etary pattern, which is rich in fruits, 
vegetables, low-fat dairy, and nuts; 
low in sodium, total fat, and satu-
rated fat; and adequate in calories 
for weight management. 
Consensus 
Consume a dietary pattern that emphasizes intake 
of vegetables, fruits, and whole grains; includes 
low-fat dairy products, poultry, fish, legumes, non-
tropical vegetable oils and nuts; and limits intake 
of sweets, sugar-sweetened beverages, and red 
meat; adapt the pattern to appropriate calorie re-
quirements; achieve this pattern by following plans
